title: Pinsa Romana
desc: Directional daylight streams from the right across the muted stone counter of an artisanal ceramic studio, casting soft chiaroscuro shadows to the left. At the center, an oval Pinsa Romana crowns a hand-shaped matte platter, its golden blistered crust layered with silky folds of Prosciutto di Parma, torn creamy burrata, and dynamic droplets of extra virgin olive oil.
businessBrief: Focusing on raw textures and natural morning light, this sequence emphasizes authenticity and artisanal craft. An excellent narrative for organic bakeries, specialty flour mills, or lifestyle brands centered around slow living and wholesome ingredients.
